channel.title: STLACCESS Blog — 3D Print Miniature Scale Conversion
channel.description: Articles about 3D printed miniature scale conversion, FDM printing tips, and the methodology behind every conversion percentage on STLACCESS.

item.title: The Ultimate Printable STL Scale Conversion Chart
item.description: Free downloadable and printable STL scale conversion chart for 3D printed miniatures. Covers 28mm, 32mm, 35mm, 40mm, 75mm tabletop, and ratio scales 1:35 through 1:100.

item.title: How to Scale Real-World Objects to 32mm Miniatures (The Math Explained)
item.description: The formula to convert real-world heights to 32mm miniature scale. Charts for humans, horses, monsters, and terrain for Warhammer, D&D, and Bolt Action.

item.title: Upscaling 3D Prints: How Big Can You Go Before You Lose Detail?
item.description: How much can you enlarge a 32mm miniature before losing detail? FDM limits, layer line visibility, and slicer settings for clean upscaling.

item.title: How to Scale Miniatures in Chitubox & Lychee Slicer (Without Messing Up the Base)
item.description: Step-by-step guide to scaling STL files in Chitubox and Lychee. Lock aspect ratios, scale without stretching the base, and understand the unit conversion.

item.title: 28mm to 32mm Scale: The Exact Percentage You Need for Your Slicer
item.description: The exact slicer percentage to scale 28mm miniatures to 32mm heroic scale: 114.3%. Plus a cheat sheet for 28mm to 35mm, 32mm to 35mm, and more.

item.title: Why Miniature Scales Use a 175cm Human Baseline
item.description: Most tabletop miniature scales are built around a 175cm (5'9) human. Here is why that number matters for 3D printing accurate scale conversions.
